sec.title: August 29 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 370)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 29** across American network radio and syndication, Robert Montgomery starring as John Adams defending the Boston Massacre on DuPont's *Cavalcade of America* (1950), Edgar Allan Poe's gothic masterpiece *The Fall of the House of Usher* on *The Weird Circle* (1943), Maurice Tarplin hosting *The Mysterious Traveler* (1950), Edward Pawley & Fran Carlon in two investigative newspaper crusades on *Big Town* (1944–1950), and Bill Stern's sports highlights for Colgate (1942–1950):
